item.name: 🧑‍⚕️ Patients [Phase 3]
item.description:
Patient registration and search.

Role Required: RECEPTION, DOCTOR, SUPER_ADMIN

Business Rules:
• Mobile number must be unique per hospital
• Search by mobile (exact) or name (starts-with)

request.description:
Register a new patient.

✅ Business Rule: Mobile number must be unique per hospital.
✅ patientId is auto-saved on success.

Search patients by mobile (exact) or name (starts-with).
Query params accepted: mobile, q, query

item.name: 📅 Visits [Phase 3]
item.description:
OPD Visit management with stage-based queue.

Role Required: RECEPTION, DOCTOR, SUPER_ADMIN (create)

Visit Stages (auto-managed):
  WAITING_FOR_HISTORY → READY_FOR_DOCTOR → READY_FOR_BILLING

Business Rules:
• doctor_id is OPTIONAL
• Patient can only have ONE open visit at a time

request.description:
Create OPD Visit (Token).

• doctor_id is OPTIONAL (nullable)
• Auto sets: status=OPEN, stage=WAITING_FOR_HISTORY
• visitId is auto-saved on success.
View all open visits waiting for history entry.
View all open visits where history is done and doctor can prescribe.
View all open visits where prescription is done, ready for billing.
Get all visit history for a specific patient (newest first).

Mark visit as COMPLETED.

Role: DOCTOR, SUPER_ADMIN

item.name: 📝 Patient History [Phase 3]
item.description:
Fill and view patient medical history per visit.

Role Required: ASSISTANT, DOCTOR, SUPER_ADMIN

Business Rules:
• Only ONE history per visit (re-submit overwrites)
• Visit must be OPEN
• On save: auto-updates stage → READY_FOR_DOCTOR

request.description:
Save patient history for a visit.

✅ Overwrites if called again (ONE per visit)
✅ Auto-updates visit stage → READY_FOR_DOCTOR

You can add any custom fields — the system stores everything as-is (schema-flexible).

item.name: 💊 Prescriptions [Phase 3]
item.description:
Patient prescriptions and medicine items.

Role Required: DOCTOR, SUPER_ADMIN (create/modify)

Business Rules:
• Only ONE prescription per visit
• Visit must be OPEN
• On create: auto-updates stage → READY_FOR_BILLING
• Multiple medicine items can be added to one prescription

request.description:
Create prescription for a visit.

✅ Only ONE prescription per visit allowed
✅ Auto-updates stage → READY_FOR_BILLING
✅ prescriptionId is auto-saved on success

Add a medicine to the prescription.

Set {{medicineId}} from the Medicines → List Medicines request first.
✅ prescriptionItemId is auto-saved on success.
Remove a specific medicine item from the prescription.

Returns complete visit info in one call:
• Patient details
• Visit info + stage
• Patient history
• Prescription
• All prescription items (medicines)
